resolved_conflicts.explanation: The directory heading says 1924, while the 1971 newspaper it quotes says 1922. The story uses 1922 because the directory ties that date to a named source (the 1971 Tuscaloosa News report), while the 1924 heading gives none. The 1971 report came 49 years after the 1922 build, so it was not written close to the event.

notes_for_editor: Both dates and the torn-down claim come from the directory page, which quotes the 1971 Tuscaloosa News; the newspaper itself was not read. The first-lookout-in-Alabama claim is the directory's and was not independently checked. UWA and Auburn archive items mention a First Fire Tower, Alabama postcard, but do not name the tower. Brief coordinates 32.3848, -88.1243 differ from TopoQuest 32.552359, -88.123634 by about 0.17 degrees of latitude (roughly 19 km); check which is right before using the map point. No source describes the site today.
